title: Listing Highlight: 90' Pershing 2007
description: 2007 90' Pershing motoryacht for sale in Miami — high-performance MTU 16V2000 power, recent teak, four cabins and master suite with ocean views.
html:
2007 90′ Pershing Motoryacht for Sale in Miami

This 90′ Pershing motoryacht (2007) is a high‑specification performance yacht located in Miami, FL.. The listing emphasizes recent exterior teak work, low‑hour MTU propulsion, and a four‑cabin layout with a prominent master suite; the summary below walks through the vessel’s main features and technical details to help assess fit and condition.

The Pershing measures 90 ft (27.43 m) with a beam of 20’5″ and a fiberglass hull, and a maximum draft of approximately 5’5″. Built to what the seller describes as very high specifications, the yacht carries a total fuel capacity of 2,378 gallons and 317 gallons of fresh water, supports four cabins and five heads, and presents an interior noted as impeccable with a master stateroom offering ocean views.

Propulsion and Performance: MTU 16V2000 Details

Propulsion is provided by MTU 16V2000 engines rated together at 2,400 HP and reported to have low hours; the advertised cruising speed is about 36 knots with a top speed near 44 knots. These figures indicate a high‑performance planing hull capable of fast coastal passages; prospective buyers should verify engine service records and request a sea trial to confirm operational condition and actual speeds under load.

Exterior, Deck and Teak: Design and Condition

The yacht’s exterior is fiberglass with a notable beam that provides substantial deck space; underwater lights are installed and most of the exterior teak has reportedly been replaced recently. The description suggests recent exterior maintenance and attention to finish work, but a detailed inspection of deck fittings, teak installation quality, and hull condition is recommended to confirm scope and workmanship.

Interior Layout and Accommodations: Four Cabins

Accommodation comprises four cabins and five heads, anchored by a large master suite with ocean views that the listing highlights. The interior is described as impeccable, implying well‑maintained joinery and systems, but buyers should review cabin arrangements, storage, ventilation and HVAC operation, and confirm the condition of upholstery, fabrics and galley appliances during a walkthrough.

Systems, Tanks and Electronics: Technical Specs

Key technical items listed include the twin MTU engines, fuel and water tank capacities (2,378 gal and 317 gal respectively), and a fiberglass hull. The listing does not provide a comprehensive electronics inventory or service history in the public text, so confirm navigation, communication, electrical systems, generators, and recent service records; include a full systems check and an electrical and plumbing inspection in pre‑purchase due diligence.

Valuation Insights at a Glance

This 90′ Pershing presents as a performance‑oriented motoryacht with high‑output MTU power, strong speed capabilities, recent exterior teak work, and a roomy four‑cabin layout highlighted by a master suite with ocean views. Interested buyers should prioritize engine log review, a comprehensive mechanical survey, and a sea trial to validate condition and performance prior to purchase.
